executive_summary: FW_v14.2.109_RC3 scores 63.2/100 (RED) on the build health index with a 96.38% pass rate. Release recommendation is NO-GO: 0 of 5 gates pass; failing: Open Blocker Jiras, Open Critical Jiras, Overall pass rate %, MTBF hours per DUT, KPI metrics passing. Projected ready 2026-11-12 against a 2026-11-10 target (AT_RISK). Top priority: Fix BTFW-4012 (LC3 codec frame buffer NULL dereference on CIS re-establishment) immediately.
tldr_bullets: Pass rate 96.38% across 6,000 HCI + phone tests (163 failed, 54 blocked), +0.45 pts vs previous build.
Full cycle took 7.47 days (179.3 h), +11.3 h over the 7-day baseline due to failure re-runs; critical path HCI_REGRESSION.
MTBF 160.0 h per DUT with 12 crashes (3 unique signatures); 1 Blocker and 6 Critical Jiras open.
KPI breaches: A2DP_Latency_ms 124.3 vs target < 100 (FAIL), A2DP_Dropouts_per_hr 1.209 vs target < 1.0 (FAIL).
release_statement: NO-GO: projected ready 2026-11-12 vs target 2026-11-10 (+2.2 days, AT_RISK). Must fix: BTFW-4012, BTFW-4031.
key_risks: BTFW-4012 (Blocker, AUDIO_CODEC) fails 4 gating tests and blocks 46 tests in 4 suites: 41 LE_Audio_CIS_BIS, 5 LE_Audio_Unicast. Indicative of a gating driver bug.

team_briefs.brief: P0 Fix BTFW-4012 (LC3 codec frame buffer NULL dereference on CIS re-establishment) immediately.
P0 Hold the release: 5 of 5 gates failing (Open Blocker Jiras, Open Critical Jiras, Overall pass rate %, MTBF hours per DUT, KPI metrics passing).
P1 Fix BTFW-4031 (Scheduler starves ISO events when A2DP ACL and LE Audio CIS run concurrently); P2 Fix BTFW-4018 (LMP response timeout during role switch with encrypted ACL).
P1 Inspect DUT-02 (EVT2 board, RF lot LOT-A17) and swap it for a DVT1 board in the next MTBF run to separate hardware from firmware causes.

P1 Run targeted subset RS-08 on the next build (619 tests, ~24 h, 86.6% shorter than the 179.3 h full cycle); P2 Merge 10 candidate duplicate clusters (26 tickets) into root-cause tickets, starting with 'ISO SDU dropped / sequence gap' (4 tickets); P2 Add an alternative setup path for LE_Audio_CIS_BIS, LE_Audio_Unicast so persistently blocked tests regain coverage while the gating bugs are open.
P2 Fix BTFW-4022 (Controller hangs on HCI_Reset issued right after A2DP stream teardown); P2 Fix BTFW-5477 (HCI_Flow_Control: Event mask not honoured).
P2 Fix BTFW-4027 (Robust caching: database hash stale after Service Changed indication).
P2 Fix BTFW-5372 (Sniff_Mode: Current draw above budget).
